cornfield.line: Me and my sister, we'd hide out in the tall cornfields
stanza: In the summer, all the lights would shine
There'd be music playing, people laughing all the time
Me and my sister, we'd hide out in the tall cornfields
Sit and listen to the mansion on the hill
Sometimes it all comes together baby
Sometimes you're a fool in love
Sometimes it all comes together baby
Sometimes you're going lose it all

windshield.line: And we wipin' snow up off the windshield
windshield.linePrev: Yeah, though it's forty below the wind chill
windshield.lineNext: It's still wonderful night to be alive, baby
